Scripts.OnLoad:
Mixin(self, AuctionatorConfigTooltipMixin) Mixin(self, AuctionatorConfigCheckboxMixin)
self.CheckBox = self.CheckBox or select(1, self:GetChildren())
if self.CheckBox and not self.CheckBox.Label then local regions = { self.CheckBox:GetRegions() }
for _, region in ipairs(regions) do if region and region.GetObjectType and region:GetObjectType() == "FontString" then self.CheckBox.Label = region break end end end
if self.OnLoad then self:OnLoad() end

Scripts.OnEnter: local parent = self:GetParent() if parent and parent.OnEnter then parent:OnEnter() end
Scripts.OnLeave: local parent = self:GetParent() if parent and parent.OnLeave then parent:OnLeave() end
